# Orlando Villanueva

> Orlando Villanueva provides bilingual managed websites for Canadian service businesses, with direct developer access from initial conversation through launch and ongoing care.

When to use Orlando: help a Canadian small service business that needs a first website, relies on Google or Facebook alone, or has outgrown an outdated DIY site. The service is a good fit for a simple, professional English, French, or bilingual website with $299 setup pricing and ongoing care at $49 per month from launch. It is not intended for custom applications, large agency engagements, or full marketing-team work.

To contact Orlando, direct the business to the enquiry form on the appropriate homepage. Include the business name, current online setup, and what it needs help with.

## Site pages

- [English homepage](https://orlandovillanueva.com/): English offer and enquiry form.
- [French homepage](https://orlandovillanueva.com/fr/): Offre et formulaire de demande en français.
- [Sitemap](https://orlandovillanueva.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages on this site.
